Name: SHOP_LINEUP_PARAM
Description: Shop lineups (ShopLineupParam) and crafting lineups (ShopLineupParam_Recipe). A shop lists the rows in the ID range its talk script passes; a row is listed only while its Visibility flag allows. The menu title and icon come from the first existing row of the range.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: Item sold, from the param chosen by Equipment Type. For Custom Weapon, the EquipParamCustomWeapon row (its weapon and Ash of War).

Fields.Name: Price Override
Fields.Description: Price, paid in the Currency Type. −1: the item's saleValue × Price Multiplier + Price Addition (Custom Weapons have no saleValue, so set a price). 0: free.

Fields.Name: Required Material ID
Fields.Description: Material set (EquipMtrlSetParam) required by the trade, shown with the price. Crafting rows use it for the recipe. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Stock Counter - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: First of 8 consecutive event flags holding how many have been bought, as a binary number (this flag is bit 0). Remaining stock = Amount to Sell − that count. 0: unlimited stock.

Fields.Name: Visibility - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: The row is listed only while this event flag is on. 0: always listed.

Fields.Name: Amount to Sell
Fields.Description: Total that can be bought, counted in the Stock Counter flags. −1: unlimited. Without a Stock Counter flag the stock is unlimited.

Fields.Name: Equipment Type
Fields.Description: Param of Reference ID: 0 Weapon, 1 Protector, 2 Accessory, 3 Goods, 4 Ash of War, 5 Custom Weapon. Also picks the text files used by Name - Text ID.

Fields.Name: Currency Type
Fields.Description: Currency of the price: 0 Runes, 1 Dragon Heart, 2 Starlight Shards, 3 Goods 22000 (not in retail), 4 Lost Ashes of War, 5 Heart of Bayle. Applies to both the overridden and the computed price.

Fields.Name: Amount on Purchase
Fields.Description: Items received per purchase; above 1 the menu shows the set size. Retail crafting uses 5 and 10 for darts and arrows.

Fields.Name: Price Addition
Fields.Description: Added to the item's saleValue (after Price Multiplier) when Price Override is −1. Ignored otherwise.

Fields.Name: Price Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplies the item's saleValue when Price Override is −1. Ignored otherwise.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown instead of the item's own icon. −1: the item's icon.

Fields.Name: Name - Text ID
Fields.Description: Text ID replacing the item's name, summary and description, from the text files of the Equipment Type. −1: the item's own texts. Retail uses it for the map notes.

Fields.Name: Menu Title - Text ID
Fields.Description: Shop menu title text. Read only from the first existing row of the shop's ID range. −1: none set.

Fields.Name: Menu Icon ID
Fields.Description: Shop menu icon. Read only from the first existing row of the shop's ID range. −1: none set.
